records.title: Human review can end in a compliant dismissal rather than restoration
records.observation: In a separate Uber Eats case, the Commission found that a human Community Operations member considered the worker’s response and that the deactivation was compliant; the application was dismissed and no reactivation, pay, or compensation was ordered.

outcomeBridges.title: Company movement versus worker control and remedy
outcomeBridges.question: Does reported AI capability or deployment movement produce more worker control, usable correction, and durable remedy?
canSupport: Company reports show commercial and operational movement.
Independent records show measured control, adoption, working-condition, or remedy observations.
The counterexample shows that human review does not guarantee restoration.
cannotSupport: These records do not follow the same named workflow, employer, worker cohort, model, or period from deployment to outcome.
The comparison does not establish that a company's reported movement caused the independent worker outcomes.
outcomeBridges.nextTest: Select one named AI-mediated workflow and follow the same population across deployment, use, correction, appeal, exit, and later result for at least two periods.

insights.title: AI can return time without returning control
insights.plainLanguageSummary: The current evidence supports a narrower reading than 'AI makes work more productive': AI can remove visible tasks while decisions, measurement, correction, and dependence remain controlled by an employer, platform, or infrastructure provider.
insights.strongestAlternative: The apparent control gap may be temporary because early deployments have not yet matured into stable workflow changes.
whatWouldChangeOurMind: A compatible longitudinal study shows durable control, pay, and remedy improvements for affected workers.
Company and independent records show that workers can understand, correct, and leave AI-mediated decisions without material penalty.
insights.nextTest: Track one named AI-mediated workflow from company deployment through worker or customer use, correction, appeal, and exit evidence.

insights.title: AI demand is building specialist layers before results are clear
insights.plainLanguageSummary: The current records show AI-related businesses appearing at several layers—compute, networking, implementation, comparison, and fundraising tools—while the customer result is still mostly unmeasured. This supports a map of where activity is forming, not a claim that the activity creates value.
insights.strongestAlternative: The apparent specialist-layer pattern may mostly reflect how the Inc. 5000 and industry sources classify growing companies, rather than a durable change in how customers buy or use AI.
whatWouldChangeOurMind: Independent customer records show that these specialist services persist after initial experimentation and produce repeatable, measurable results.
Longitudinal evidence shows customers can compare, correct, replace, or exit these systems without material loss of control.
The businesses lose their distinct role as general-purpose platforms absorb the work without reducing customer choice or increasing dependence.
insights.nextTest: For one named customer workflow, trace the supplier, implementation step, actual use, correction path, switching option, and later result across at least two reporting periods.
